name: ccc
description: CCC contained-session lifecycle hooks and /ccc commands for Codex. Injected read-only into the bwrap sandbox by ccc-agent run for contained Codex sessions only; never loaded by a direct `codex` run. SessionStart/SubagentStart/SubagentStop hooks maintain trusted workspace scopes, while the Stop hook signals turn boundaries to the supervisor over the control socket; hooks never hold direct commit authority.
